bel.name: Bharat Electronics Ltd (BEL)
bel.short: Defence electronics: radars, electronic warfare, communication and air-defence systems
bel.what: BEL is the government-owned defence electronics maker. It builds radars, electronic warfare suites, communication equipment, fire-control and air-defence systems, and increasingly non-defence electronics.
bel.note: Electronics content in modern weapons is rising, which is why BEL sits at the top of the index.

hal.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL)
hal.short: Military aircraft and helicopters (e.g. Tejas fighter, ALH/LCH helicopters) and aero-engine overhaul
hal.what: HAL designs, builds and maintains military aircraft and helicopters for India's armed forces — including the Tejas light combat aircraft and indigenous helicopters — and overhauls aero-engines.
hal.note: Its revenue is closely tied to the aircraft and aero-engine part of the defence capex budget.

bharatforge.name: Bharat Forge Ltd
bharatforge.short: Forgings for automobiles and industry, plus artillery and defence systems
bharatforge.what: Bharat Forge is one of the world's large forging companies, supplying engine and chassis components to vehicle and industrial makers. Its defence business makes artillery guns and other systems.
bharatforge.note: That's why the factsheet classifies it as 'Automobile & Auto Components' — 13.27% of the defence index comes from this one stock.

solar.name: Solar Industries India Ltd
solar.short: Industrial explosives and defence ammunition/energetic materials
solar.what: Despite the name, Solar Industries makes explosives — for mining and infrastructure — and defence products such as ammunition, propellants and other energetic materials.
solar.note: Classified under 'Chemicals' in the index; the name often confuses clients.

mtar.name: MTAR Technologies Ltd
mtar.short: Precision-engineered components for nuclear, space, defence and clean-energy customers
mtar.what: MTAR manufactures high-precision components and assemblies used in nuclear reactors, space launch vehicles, defence systems and clean-energy equipment such as fuel cells.
mtar.note: A smaller, more specialised company — weights like 4% can move a lot with its share price.

mazdock.name: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd
mazdock.short: Warships and submarines for the Indian Navy
mazdock.what: Mazagon Dock in Mumbai builds destroyers, frigates and submarines for the Indian Navy.
mazdock.note: Its business depends on large, multi-year naval orders.

astramicro.name: Astra Microwave Products Ltd
astramicro.short: RF and microwave subsystems for radars, electronic warfare, space and weather systems
astramicro.what: Astra Microwave designs and manufactures radio-frequency and microwave sub-systems used in defence radars, electronic warfare, satellites and meteorological systems.
astramicro.note: A supplier to larger system integrators like BEL and DRDO programmes.

datapatterns.name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
datapatterns.short: Defence electronics: radars, electronic warfare, avionics and processing systems
datapatterns.what: Data Patterns builds defence and aerospace electronics — radars, electronic warfare systems, avionics and rugged processing hardware.
datapatterns.note: One of the private electronics players benefiting from indigenisation.

cochin.name: Cochin Shipyard Ltd
cochin.short: Shipbuilding and ship repair; built INS Vikrant
cochin.what: Cochin Shipyard builds and repairs ships, including India's indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant, and commercial vessels.
cochin.note: Ship repair gives it a steadier revenue stream than shipbuilding alone.

bdl.name: Bharat Dynamics Ltd (BDL)
bdl.short: Missiles: surface-to-air, air-to-air and anti-tank guided missiles
bdl.what: BDL manufactures missiles for the armed forces — including surface-to-air systems such as Akash and the Astra air-to-air missile — along with anti-tank guided missiles and underwater weapons.
bdl.note: Air-defence priorities after 2025 make missile makers a closely watched part of the theme.

tatasteel.name: Tata Steel Ltd
tatasteel.short: Integrated steel producer in India with operations in Europe
tatasteel.what: Tata Steel makes steel from iron ore through to finished products in India, and also has steel operations in the Netherlands and the UK.
tatasteel.note: Steel companies' profits swing with global steel prices and demand — that's why metal indices are cyclical.

hindalco.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
hindalco.short: Aluminium and copper; owns Novelis (aluminium rolled products, e.g. beverage cans)
hindalco.what: Hindalco produces aluminium and copper in India and owns Novelis, a global maker of rolled aluminium used in beverage cans, cars and buildings.
hindalco.note: A large part of its earnings come from outside India through Novelis.

jswsteel.name: JSW Steel Ltd
jswsteel.short: One of India's largest steel producers
jswsteel.what: JSW Steel is among India's largest steelmakers, with large integrated plants and a wide range of flat and long steel products.
jswsteel.note: Infrastructure and auto demand drive its volumes; steel prices drive its margins.

adanient.name: Adani Enterprises Ltd
adanient.short: Adani group's flagship: mining and trading, airports, roads, data centres and new energy businesses
adanient.what: Adani Enterprises is the group's incubator company. It runs mining and resource trading alongside newer businesses like airports, roads, data centres and green energy manufacturing.
adanient.note: Its mining and trading business is why it appears in a metals index — a good example of index classification surprises.

vedal.name: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Ltd
vedal.short: Aluminium business separated from Vedanta Ltd and listed on its own
vedal.what: This company holds the aluminium business that was demerged from Vedanta Ltd and separately listed.
vedal.note: Demergers change index membership — one company can become two constituents.

vedanta.name: Vedanta Ltd
vedanta.short: Diversified natural resources: zinc (via Hindustan Zinc), oil & gas, iron ore and more
vedanta.what: Vedanta is a natural-resources company with interests in zinc (through its holding in Hindustan Zinc), oil and gas, iron ore, power and other metals.
vedanta.note: After demergers, check which businesses remain inside 'Vedanta Ltd'.

jindalsteel.name: Jindal Steel Ltd
jindalsteel.what: Jindal Steel makes steel products including rails, plates and structural steel; it was earlier named Jindal Steel & Power.
jindalsteel.note: Name changes are common — RMs should recognise companies under new names.

aplapollo.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd
aplapollo.short: Structural steel tubes and pipes for construction
aplapollo.what: APL Apollo is India's leading maker of structural steel tubes used in buildings, warehouses, infrastructure and homes.
aplapollo.note: It processes steel rather than making it — closer to construction demand than to mining.

nalco.name: National Aluminium Co. Ltd (NALCO)
nalco.short: Bauxite mining, alumina refining and aluminium smelting
nalco.what: NALCO is a government-owned company that mines bauxite, refines it into alumina and smelts aluminium.
nalco.note: A large alumina exporter, so global alumina prices matter.

hindzinc.name: Hindustan Zinc Ltd
hindzinc.short: Zinc, lead and silver mining — one of the world's large silver producers
hindzinc.what: Hindustan Zinc mines and smelts zinc and lead and produces silver as a by-product, making it one of the world's significant silver producers.
hindzinc.note: Connects to the silver lessons: most silver comes as a by-product of zinc, lead and copper mining.

infy.name: Infosys Ltd
infy.short: IT services, consulting and digital transformation for global clients
infy.what: Infosys provides IT services, consulting and outsourcing to large companies worldwide, with most revenue from North America and Europe.
infy.note: It has the highest weight in Nifty IT partly because almost all its shares are free-float.

tcs.name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd (TCS)
tcs.short: India's largest IT services company by revenue
tcs.what: TCS provides IT services, consulting and business solutions to global clients and is part of the Tata group.
tcs.note: Tata Sons holds a large stake in TCS, so a smaller share of it is free-float. Index weight follows free-float value, not total company size.

hcltech.name: HCL Technologies Ltd
hcltech.short: IT services plus engineering services and software products
hcltech.what: HCLTech offers IT and engineering services and also earns revenue from its own software products.
hcltech.note: The software products business makes its mix different from pure services peers.

techm.name: Tech Mahindra Ltd
techm.short: IT services with a large telecom and communications focus
techm.what: Tech Mahindra provides IT services with a strong presence among telecom companies, alongside other industries.
techm.note: Telecom spending cycles affect it more than most peers.

coforge.name: Coforge Ltd
coforge.short: Mid-sized IT services firm focused on banking, insurance and travel
coforge.what: Coforge is a mid-sized IT services company serving financial services, insurance and travel clients.
coforge.note: Mid-tier IT firms have gained weight relative to the giants in recent years.

persistent.name: Persistent Systems Ltd
persistent.short: Software product engineering and digital services
persistent.what: Persistent builds and modernises software for technology companies, banks and healthcare clients.
persistent.note: Known for product-engineering work rather than traditional outsourcing.

wipro.name: Wipro Ltd
wipro.what: Wipro provides IT services, consulting and business process services to global clients.
wipro.note: One of the original large Indian IT companies.

ltm.name: LTM Ltd (formerly LTIMindtree)
ltm.short: IT services company of the Larsen & Toubro group
ltm.what: LTM, formerly LTIMindtree, is the L&T group's IT services company formed from the merger of L&T Infotech and Mindtree; it adopted the LTM name in 2026.
ltm.note: A recent name change — clients may still call it LTIMindtree.

mphasis.name: Mphasis Ltd
mphasis.short: IT services focused on banking and financial services
mphasis.what: Mphasis provides IT services with a strong focus on banking, financial services and insurance clients.
mphasis.note: Concentration in BFSI clients drives its business cycle.

ofss.name: Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd
ofss.short: Banking software products (core banking and related platforms)
ofss.what: OFSS sells banking software products — such as core banking platforms — to banks worldwide. It is a subsidiary of Oracle.
ofss.note: A software-product company, unlike most services-led constituents.

reliance.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
reliance.short: Oil-to-chemicals, Jio telecom, retail and new energy
reliance.what: Reliance runs oil refining and petrochemicals, India's largest telecom network (Jio) through a subsidiary, a large retail business and new-energy projects.
reliance.note: It is classified under Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels — so 'infrastructure' in this index is 27% oil & gas.

airtel.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
airtel.short: Mobile, broadband and enterprise telecom in India and Africa
airtel.what: Bharti Airtel provides mobile, broadband and enterprise connectivity in India and, through a subsidiary, in several African countries.
airtel.note: Telecom is treated as infrastructure because networks are long-life assets.

lt.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd (L&T)
lt.short: Engineering & construction: infrastructure, energy, defence, heavy engineering
lt.what: L&T designs and builds large projects — roads, metros, power plants, refineries, factories — and also has defence, heavy engineering and IT businesses.
lt.note: Order inflows from government and private capex drive its outlook.

ntpc.name: NTPC Ltd
ntpc.short: India's largest power generator (coal, gas and growing renewables)
ntpc.what: NTPC is India's largest power generation company, mainly coal-based, with a fast-growing renewable energy business.
ntpc.note: Regulated returns make power utilities steadier than metals or IT.

adaniports.name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd
adaniports.short: India's largest private port operator, plus logistics
adaniports.what: Adani Ports operates ports and terminals across India's coastline and runs logistics businesses linked to them.
adaniports.note: Port volumes follow trade and industrial activity.

ultratech.name: UltraTech Cement Ltd
ultratech.what: UltraTech makes cement and building materials and is India's largest cement company by capacity.
ultratech.note: Cement demand tracks housing and infrastructure construction.

powergrid.name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
powergrid.what: Power Grid builds and operates most of India's inter-state electricity transmission network.
powergrid.note: Earns regulated returns on its transmission assets.

grasim.name: Grasim Industries Ltd
grasim.short: Viscose fibre, chemicals, paints (Birla Opus) and holding company of UltraTech
grasim.what: Grasim makes viscose staple fibre and chemicals, has entered decorative paints, and holds the group's stakes in UltraTech Cement and financial services.
grasim.note: Part operating company, part holding company.

indigo.name: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd (IndiGo)
indigo.what: InterGlobe Aviation runs IndiGo, India's largest airline by passengers.
indigo.note: Fuel prices and the rupee strongly affect airline costs.

ongc.name: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Ltd (ONGC)
ongc.short: India's largest crude oil and natural gas producer
ongc.what: ONGC explores for and produces crude oil and natural gas, mainly in India, with refining interests through subsidiaries.
ongc.note: Crude oil prices drive its earnings.

hi.bel: रक्षा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स: रडार, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक युद्ध, संचार और एयर-डिफेंस सिस्टम
hi.hal: सैन्य विमान और हेलीकॉप्टर (जैसे तेजस फ़ाइटर) और एयरो-इंजन ओवरहॉल
hi.bharatforge: वाहनों और उद्योग के लिए फ़ोर्जिंग, साथ में तोपें और रक्षा सिस्टम
hi.solar: औद्योगिक विस्फोटक और रक्षा गोला-बारूद/ऊर्जावान सामग्री
hi.mtar: परमाणु, अंतरिक्ष, रक्षा और स्वच्छ ऊर्जा ग्राहकों के लिए सटीक इंजीनियर्ड पुर्ज़े
hi.mazdock: भारतीय नौसेना के लिए युद्धपोत और पनडुब्बियाँ
hi.astramicro: रडार, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक युद्ध, अंतरिक्ष और मौसम सिस्टम के लिए RF और माइक्रोवेव सबसिस्टम
hi.datapatterns: रक्षा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स: रडार, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक युद्ध, एवियोनिक्स और प्रोसेसिंग सिस्टम
hi.cochin: जहाज़ निर्माण और मरम्मत; INS विक्रांत बनाया
hi.bdl: मिसाइलें: ज़मीन-से-हवा, हवा-से-हवा और एंटी-टैंक गाइडेड मिसाइलें
hi.tatasteel: भारत में एकीकृत स्टील उत्पादक, यूरोप में भी कारोबार
hi.hindalco: एल्युमिनियम और कॉपर; Novelis की मालिक (एल्युमिनियम रोल्ड उत्पाद, जैसे बेवरेज कैन)
hi.jswsteel: भारत के सबसे बड़े स्टील उत्पादकों में से एक
hi.adanient: अदाणी समूह की प्रमुख कंपनी: खनन व ट्रेडिंग, एयरपोर्ट, सड़कें, डेटा सेंटर और नई ऊर्जा
hi.vedal: Vedanta Ltd से अलग होकर अलग से सूचीबद्ध एल्युमिनियम कारोबार
hi.vedanta: विविध प्राकृतिक संसाधन: ज़िंक (हिंदुस्तान ज़िंक के ज़रिए), तेल-गैस, लौह अयस्क आदि
hi.jindalsteel: स्टील उत्पादक (पहले जिंदल स्टील एंड पावर)
hi.aplapollo: निर्माण के लिए स्ट्रक्चरल स्टील ट्यूब और पाइप
hi.nalco: बॉक्साइट खनन, एल्युमिना रिफ़ाइनिंग और एल्युमिनियम उत्पादन
hi.hindzinc: ज़िंक, लेड और सिल्वर खनन — दुनिया के बड़े सिल्वर उत्पादकों में से एक
hi.infy: वैश्विक ग्राहकों के लिए IT सेवाएँ, कंसल्टिंग और डिजिटल बदलाव
hi.tcs: राजस्व के हिसाब से भारत की सबसे बड़ी IT सेवा कंपनी
hi.hcltech: IT सेवाएँ, साथ में इंजीनियरिंग सेवाएँ और सॉफ़्टवेयर उत्पाद
hi.techm: IT सेवाएँ, टेलीकॉम और संचार पर बड़ा फ़ोकस
hi.coforge: बैंकिंग, बीमा और ट्रैवल पर केंद्रित मध्यम आकार की IT सेवा कंपनी
hi.persistent: सॉफ़्टवेयर प्रोडक्ट इंजीनियरिंग और डिजिटल सेवाएँ
hi.ltm: लार्सन एंड टुब्रो समूह की IT सेवा कंपनी
hi.mphasis: बैंकिंग और वित्तीय सेवाओं पर केंद्रित IT सेवाएँ
hi.ofss: बैंकिंग सॉफ़्टवेयर उत्पाद (कोर बैंकिंग और संबंधित प्लेटफ़ॉर्म)
hi.reliance: ऑयल-टू-केमिकल्स, Jio टेलीकॉम, रिटेल और नई ऊर्जा
hi.airtel: भारत और अफ़्रीका में मोबाइल, ब्रॉडबैंड और एंटरप्राइज़ टेलीकॉम
hi.lt: इंजीनियरिंग और निर्माण: इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर, ऊर्जा, रक्षा, भारी इंजीनियरिंग
hi.ntpc: भारत की सबसे बड़ी बिजली उत्पादक (कोयला, गैस और बढ़ती नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा)
hi.adaniports: भारत का सबसे बड़ा निजी पोर्ट ऑपरेटर, साथ में लॉजिस्टिक्स
hi.ultratech: भारत की सबसे बड़ी सीमेंट उत्पादक
hi.grasim: विस्कोस फ़ाइबर, केमिकल्स, पेंट (Birla Opus) और UltraTech की होल्डिंग कंपनी
hi.ongc: भारत की सबसे बड़ी कच्चा तेल और प्राकृतिक गैस उत्पादक

gu.bel: સંરક્ષણ ઇલેક્ટ્રોનિક્સ: રડાર, ઇલેક્ટ્રોનિક યુદ્ધ, સંદેશાવ્યવહાર અને એર-ડિફેન્સ સિસ્ટમ
gu.hal: લશ્કરી વિમાન અને હેલિકોપ્ટર (જેમ કે તેજસ ફાઇટર) અને એરો-એન્જિન ઓવરહોલ
gu.bharatforge: વાહનો અને ઉદ્યોગ માટે ફોર્જિંગ, સાથે તોપો અને સંરક્ષણ સિસ્ટમ
gu.solar: ઔદ્યોગિક વિસ્ફોટકો અને સંરક્ષણ દારૂગોળો/ઊર્જાવાન સામગ્રી
gu.mtar: પરમાણુ, અવકાશ, સંરક્ષણ અને સ્વચ્છ ઊર્જા ગ્રાહકો માટે ચોકસાઈવાળા એન્જિનિયર્ડ ભાગો
gu.mazdock: ભારતીય નૌકાદળ માટે યુદ્ધજહાજ અને સબમરીન
gu.astramicro: રડાર, ઇલેક્ટ્રોનિક યુદ્ધ, અવકાશ અને હવામાન સિસ્ટમ માટે RF અને માઇક્રોવેવ સબસિસ્ટમ
gu.datapatterns: સંરક્ષણ ઇલેક્ટ્રોનિક્સ: રડાર, ઇલેક્ટ્રોનિક યુદ્ધ, એવિયોનિક્સ અને પ્રોસેસિંગ સિસ્ટમ
gu.cochin: જહાજ નિર્માણ અને સમારકામ; INS વિક્રાંત બનાવ્યું
gu.bdl: મિસાઇલ: જમીનથી-હવામાં, હવાથી-હવામાં અને એન્ટી-ટેન્ક ગાઇડેડ મિસાઇલ
gu.tatasteel: ભારતમાં સંકલિત સ્ટીલ ઉત્પાદક, યુરોપમાં પણ કામગીરી
gu.hindalco: એલ્યુમિનિયમ અને કોપર; Novelis ની માલિક (એલ્યુમિનિયમ રોલ્ડ ઉત્પાદનો, જેમ કે બેવરેજ કેન)
gu.jswsteel: ભારતના સૌથી મોટા સ્ટીલ ઉત્પાદકોમાંની એક
gu.adanient: અદાણી જૂથની મુખ્ય કંપની: ખાણકામ અને ટ્રેડિંગ, એરપોર્ટ, રસ્તા, ડેટા સેન્ટર અને નવી ઊર્જા
gu.vedal: Vedanta Ltd થી અલગ થઈ અલગથી સૂચિબદ્ધ એલ્યુમિનિયમ વ્યવસાય
gu.vedanta: વૈવિધ્યસભર કુદરતી સંસાધનો: ઝિંક (હિંદુસ્તાન ઝિંક દ્વારા), તેલ-ગેસ, લોખંડ અયસ્ક વગેરે
gu.jindalsteel: સ્ટીલ ઉત્પાદક (પહેલાં જિંદાલ સ્ટીલ એન્ડ પાવર)
gu.aplapollo: બાંધકામ માટે સ્ટ્રક્ચરલ સ્ટીલ ટ્યૂબ અને પાઇપ
